title.zh: 【Metaplanet：第三季度净购入 1000 枚 BTC，总持有量达到 4.4 万枚】
title.en: 【Metaplanet：第三季度净购入 1000 枚 BTC，总持有量达到 4.4 万枚】

current_state.zh: Japan-listed Metaplanet said it net-bought 1,000 BTC in its fiscal Q3, lifting total holdings to 44,000 BTC, after selling 10,000 BTC and repurchasing 11,000 BTC to demonstrate its ability to monetize its bitcoin reserves.
current_state.en: Japan-listed Metaplanet said it net-bought 1,000 BTC in its fiscal Q3, lifting total holdings to 44,000 BTC, after selling 10,000 BTC and repurchasing 11,000 BTC to demonstrate its ability to monetize its bitcoin reserves.
